images.title: Rows times columns
images.purpose: Show that the number of rows times the number of columns equals 12, so rows and columns are factors of 12.
images.composition: One centred dot grid with a row label on the left and a column label under it, and a line of text below.
images.exact_structure: One grid of exactly 12 equal teal #0072B2 round dots in 2 rows and 6 columns with equal gaps. A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket on the left spans the 2 rows. A reddish purple bracket underneath spans the 6 columns. Grey #6B7280 outline around the grid. Exactly 1 grid, 12 dots, 2 brackets.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a grid with a number of dots other than 12
images.takeaway: Rows times columns gives 12, so rows and columns are factors of 12.
images.description: A grid of 12 teal dots in 2 rows and 6 columns with brackets for the rows and columns.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say the number of rows and columns, then multiply them to get 12.

image_decisions.why: One clean picture carries the main idea of this concept.
